before.name: Hellbent
before.tooltip:
Striking enemy champions with Attacks or Abilities grants you a stack of Revivemaxxing for @Stacks_Duration@ seconds (max: @Stacks_Max@). At max stacks become Hellbent.

Hellbent: Upon dying, revive over the course of @Revive_Duration@ seconds at @Calc_Revive_Max_Health@ max Health. Afterwards, you gain @Calc_AdaptiveForce@ Adaptive Force, @Calc_MoveSpeed@ Move Speed towards enemy champions, and @Calc_Omnivamp@ Omnivamp for @Buff_Duration@ seconds.

This has a @Cooldown@ second cooldown.

before.name: Spirit Bomb
before.tooltip:
Healing and Shielding builds up a Spirit Bomb. At max stacks, toss the Spirit Bomb at your lowest Health ally. After reaching the target, it heals nearby allies for @Calc_Heal@ of their missing Health and grants them a @Calc_Shield@ current Health shield for @Shield_Duration@ seconds.

Spirit Bombs Tossed: @f1.0@
Healing: @f2.0@
Shielding: @f3.0@

Point Runner: Grants +30% bonus Move Speed that builds up over 2 seconds when near turrets or void gates. Active 150s
Spawns a gate at the target location for 150 seconds (Can't be placed near turrets). Every 4 seconds the gate spawns a volatile Voidspawn that travels down the nearest lane.

After 4 seconds, a Voidspawn's health will rapidly decay to 0. The fourth Voidspawn and every Voidspawn thereafter will deal bonus damage equal to 50% of your resistances.
